svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three from stock 110 mm PVC drainage parts: a 110 x 50 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: concentric reducer, a 110 mm end cap and 94 mm of 110 mm pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the 110 pipe square to 94 mm and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 20.5 mm holes for the M20 conduit fittings, opposite each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: other, centred 46 mm up from the pipe's lower end (check the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fitting's datasheet). One faces upslope, one downslope.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the pipe fully into the reducer's 110 socket and the cap onto

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the outside in a bright colour for visibility.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the reducer's 50 mm socket goes over the stake pipe on a tape

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wrap; two M5 self-tapping screws hold it, drilled through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: socket into the pipe at assembly, 20 mm above the socket rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the head stands 330 mm above ground on the stake.
